resources.string: Avoid dying by running but beware of comms.[nl]Use [b]Caffeine[/b] to boost yourself.
Kill the Killers with your 6th sense.
Kill players who have killed others in the past 15 secs.[nl]But don't accidentally kill your own teamates
Guess players who have killed in the last 15 seconds to kill them
Opens a Player menu, guess a player who has killed in the last 15 seconds
Cure the Imposters with your needle
Inject someone, if they kill anyone, they get "cured"
The Syringe is a Crewmate Power Role that can inject Evil Doers to "Cure" (i.e. kill) them when they kill someone. But Be careful to not accidentally inject Crew as they might Die or Become Traitors
Inject a player. If they're a Evil Doer, kill them when the Evil Doer kills anyone. If they're Crew, either you die along with them, they become a Traitor, or nothing happens
With each guess your power grows"
Discover Players and guess them correctly during meetings to gain new abilities.[nl]Kill everyone to win!
The Marksman is a Neutral Killing Role that can Discover players and guess them correctly during meetings to gain new abilities. Needs to be the last killer standing to win
Select a player, discovering a hint in the next meeting what their role could be.
Activate a Smokebomb and blind everyone in it
Mark a player to teleport to them at any time in the game. Can only be used once per round and resets every round
Turn mostly invisible. Cannot kill in this state
Completely disable player's abilities and movement while also blinding them. Can only be used once and lasts one round, does not work in the final 5
When it guesses successfully, it's target does not go under the meeting death animation and instantly skip. Their vote will not count
Can Discover 2 players in one round
